input.task: Reveal the audit code in the inspector's control panel and report it.

provenance: M42 leg (a), the shadow-DOM half — and the measurement corrected a premise. An OPEN shadow root is ALREADY in Chromium's accessibility tree and Playwright's locators already pierce it, so `observe` listed the button and `resolve` clicked it before this milestone. What was structurally blind was the EVIDENCE pipeline: `page.inner_text('body')` does not traverse shadow roots (measured: `'NBX-7741' in body` -> False while the same value read back off the locator), so a correct shadow read was failed as ungrounded by the verifier, `check_state`'s `text_visible` could never see shadow content, and `page_changed` was blind to a shadow-only mutation. A correct answer graded wrong is the same run-killer as an unreachable element and a worse one to debug.
